title: A Teen Absorbed An Alien's Laser And Fired It Back . . . (Part 2)
caption:
A teenager absorbed an alien hunter's laser and fired it back 👽 Absolute Ben 10, chapters 4-6: Gwen breaks out of a burning cabin while Ben fights Kraab. Follow for Part 3!

#absoluteben10 #ben10 #manhwarecap #webtoon #recap
comment: Would you have lied to Gwen about the watch like Ben did? Why? 👀

segments.say: A teenager just *absorbed* a giant laser with his own body, then fired it all back at the alien who wanted to sell him as meat.
To see how it got here, go back to the night a giant alien *hunter* came for Ben's watch.
He cornered Ben's cousin Gwen alone in the dark, and asked her one thing. Where is the *Omnitrix*?
Gwen was shaking. But she still raised her *fists* and asked where her cousin was.
Kraab only laughed. He gave her points for bravery, then offered a deal. Help me find the watch, and I'll help you find your *cousin*.
Gwen answered with a *punch*. Main-character energy, honestly.
Meanwhile, far away, Ben's watch ran out of power, and he turned back into a *human*.
He stared at the watch. So *this* was the guy he turned into.
Now he had to explain this thing to Aunt Nat. And then she *called*.
Ben lied right to her face. He said Gwen was fine, and just *nearby*.
Then it hit him. Gwen came back to check on him, even after he *snapped* at her. He felt like a total jerk.
So he ran back. And found her *phone* on the ground. That is never a good sign.
Then a huge voice shouted, come out now, *kid*!
Kraab was done with this stinky planet. He wanted his *watch*, right now.
Ben wanted to run for help. Then he stopped. Maybe he *was* the help.
He slammed the watch, and Kraab fired a giant *laser* at him.
When the smoke cleared, Ben was a black alien with *cables* for arms. That was close, he said.
Kraab sneered. So you actually figured out how to use it. Ben didn't care. He only wanted his *cousin* back.
Kraab said good, and swung a giant *claw* at him.
Ben dodged the chain and hit him with everything. Kraab didn't even *flinch*.
Don't worry about your cousin, he said. I know a few guys who pay a pretty penny for *human meat*.
What a charming guy.
Then he ripped out one of Ben's cables and called him an *amateur*.
Ben tried to joke back. Kraab stabbed the cable straight into him and *electrocuted* him.
Kraab was loving it. Now we're having *fun*, he laughed.
Get up, he said. But Ben could barely *move*.
Two campers were hiding nearby, watching the monsters fight. One of them said that cabin screamed *death trap*.
He had no idea someone was *inside*.
Because Gwen had just woken up in the middle of *fire*.
Don't panic, she told herself. Stay positive, Gwendolyn. *Breathe*.
Her eyes glowed blue, and she shouted words only a *witch* would know.
It didn't work at first. C'mon, this is just a *basic* spell.
Then she screamed *shatter*, and the fire burst open around her.
She did it. Gwen could do *magic*, and she was already running back for Ben.
Back at the fight, Ben begged. Just tell me where my cousin is, and you can have this *stupid* thing.
Kraab said nice of you to comply, and punched him in the *face*.
But there was a catch. He couldn't kill Ben. The Omnitrix had *bonded* to him, so Kraab had to take Ben along with it.
Ben asked, can't you just take it off? Kraab said that is *practically* impossible.
Then he looked around, and froze. Gwen had *escaped*.
She's caused me more issues than you, he growled, and aimed right at *Gwen*.
Ben screamed *no*.
Kraab smirked. You're still conscious? I can fix *that*.
Ben caught his fist mid-swing. And he *roared*.
Lightning cracked off his body like he was going *Super Saiyan*.
Kraab charged one last blast, bigger than anything *before*.
Ben didn't dodge. His chest *opened* up.
He *drank* the whole thing. Kraab's face said it all.
Then Ben fired every bit of it right back in one giant *beam*.
Never underestimate a *teenager*.
Kraab burned. Ben fell to his knees, and the watch beeped *red*. He was human again.
Then Gwen ran in, shouted his name, and threw her arms *around* him.
She asked what happened to his arm. Ben covered the watch and said he was *fine*. Terrible liar.
He grinned. Nobody gets up from *that*. Gwen looked at the crater and agreed. He does look pretty *dead*.
Come on, she said. Let's get you checked *out*.
But Ben went quiet. Behind them, the burnt shell was still *glowing*.
Kraab wasn't dead. He sent a *signal* into space. And whoever hears it is coming for *Ben*.
